evidence.title: Applied Digital Reports Fiscal Third Quarter 2026 Results
evidence.excerpt: Applied Digital says crews were advancing two 150 MW Polaris Forge 1 facilities in parallel, both Polaris Forge 2 buildings were progressing, and Delta Forge 1 had broken ground.
